text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the time has come to reclaim 
what was lost.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The glory that once slipped through my 
grasp— 
today, I shall claim it with my own 
hands...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, naturally. 
I have honed my blade for this very day.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A flower that blooms through hardship is 
all the stronger 
and more exquisite. —Just watch me.
